subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw pursue native/core support for any of the three requested tracks: batched tool inputs, AI-callable context block lifecycle tools, and strict submitted-plan enforcement?
rationale: The source check shows the requested surfaces are still missing, but each one adds core API, settings, persistence, or orchestration behavior that cannot be safely chosen by cleanup automation.

options.title: Split into design tracks
options.body: Keep this open as an umbrella only long enough to create focused maintainer-owned design issues for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement.

options.title: Narrow to context lifecycle
options.body: Move only the context block/manual clearing portion to the existing context-clearing discussion and leave batching and plan enforcement unplanned.

options.title: Reject core orchestration
options.body: Close the request as out of scope for core unless a plugin/API gap is demonstrated for a smaller piece.

recommendation.title: Split into design tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this open as an umbrella only long enough to create focused maintainer-owned design issues for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest cross-surface history across update_plan, strict-agentic execution, file-tool params, and web-search routing.
